open_points.text: activate_budget_version: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST validate version ownership and unresolved-allocation policy, atomically deactivate the prior active version, activate exactly the requested version, and append an audit with the snapshot.activate member of = models.AuditAction without granting producers this operation.
open_points.question: Must the note name the enum member SNAPSHOT_ACTIVATE, or is snapshot.activate intended to be a member name despite the declared enum surface?

open_points.subject: activate_budget_version audit orchestration note
open_points.text: activate_budget_version: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST append exactly one audit whose intent the imported build_project_audit_intent builds from the context, the snapshot.activate member of = models.AuditAction, the BUDGET_VERSION member of = models.AuditEntityKind and the requested version_id as entity_id, commit the version changes and audit atomically, and return the result the imported build_budget_activation_result builds from the activated BudgetVersion object, its ordered plans and the pre-update unresolved allocation count.
open_points.question: Must the note name SNAPSHOT_ACTIVATE rather than treating its value snapshot.activate as the member name?

open_points.text: activate_budget_version: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST require the capability of the context to be the portal.estimate_snapshot.activate member of = models.Capability and raise BudgetValidationError before opening a transaction otherwise; no other capability or producer context may activate a version.
open_points.question: Must the note name PORTAL_ESTIMATE_SNAPSHOT_ACTIVATE rather than treating its value portal.estimate_snapshot.activate as the member name?

open_points.text: ensure_manual_budget: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] When no manual version exists, MUST build the new = models.BudgetVersion with the imported build_manual_budget_version, passing the context and the single utc_now instant as now, insert that exact object, build exactly one audit intent with the imported build_project_audit_intent from the context, the budget.manual_version_create member of = models.AuditAction, the BUDGET_VERSION member of = models.AuditEntityKind and the new version_id as entity_id and append it via the audit repository PortalTransaction.audit returns, commit once, and return the detail the imported build_budget_version_detail builds from the same BudgetVersion object, empty plans and zero unresolved allocations.
open_points.question: Must the note name BUDGET_MANUAL_VERSION_CREATE rather than treating its value budget.manual_version_create as the member name?
